deliveryLog.message: Identify who will use the site, what they need, and where they get stuck

process.title: Discovery & Planning
process.description: We clarify business goals, target users, current blockers, success metrics, technical requirements, and project scope.

process.title: Solution Design
process.description: I define the structure before build: page flow, components, APIs, CMS needs, integrations, hosting, and deployment plan.

process.title: Development
process.description: I build in visible milestones with clean, responsive, maintainable implementation and feedback loops throughout.

process.title: Testing & QA
process.description: Functionality, forms, responsiveness, browser behavior, performance, accessibility, and edge cases are checked before launch.

process.title: Deployment & Launch
process.description: Production deployment, domain and hosting setup, SSL, analytics, final QA, and launch handoff are handled carefully.

process.title: Support & Growth
process.description: After launch, I can help with improvements, maintenance, new features, performance monitoring, and scaling needs.

about.story: I started web development in 2018. In the early times, I did not have an internet connection at home, so I used my friends' internet to download tutorials, then watched them offline to learn HTML, CSS, and the fundamentals. That beginning made me self-learned, resourceful, and passionate about building useful things.
about.homeIntro: I’m a web developer in Faisalabad, Pakistan. AI helps me try ideas quickly. I write more specific prompts as the work takes shape and review the code before I use it.
about.motivation: I like fixing the parts of a website people deal with every day: a slow page, a form that’s hard to use, or content that takes too many steps to update.
about.originStory: I started learning web development in 2018. I didn’t have internet at home, so I used my friends’ connections to download tutorials. I watched them offline and learned HTML and CSS by building pages myself.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: I usually need 3–10 days for a small landing page and 2–5 weeks for a redesign or product front end. The timeline depends on what we’re building and when content and feedback are ready.

faqs.question: Do you only design or also develop?
faqs.answer: Development is my main work. I can build from your design, help improve what you already have, or plan the page with you before I start coding.

faqs.question: What can I hire you for?
faqs.answer: You can hire me to redesign a site, build a product interface, or add an AI feature to an existing tool. I also fix mobile layouts, speed up pages, and help make online stores easier to use.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. I work remotely with founders, agencies, businesses, and product teams across different time zones.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. After launch I can help with maintenance, bug fixes, new sections, performance improvements, and feature enhancements.

faqs.question: Do you share pricing upfront?
faqs.answer: Yes. I list starting prices on the Services page. Once I know how many pages you need, what the site connects to, and when you need it, I can give you a quote.
